article.story: BOWLING GREEN, Ohio -- — Josiah Shackelford had 25 points in Bowling Green's 95-79 win against Cleveland State on Monday. Shackelford also contributed six rebounds for the Falcons. Makhi Leach added 22 points while shooting 7 for 13 (1 for 4 from 3-point range) and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line while they also had eight assists and three steals. Zach Howell had 12 points and shot 4 for 8, including 3 for 6 from beyond the arc for Bowling Green. Rayvon Griffith led the Vikings (1-2) in scoring, finishing with 26 points. Curtis Stinson Jr. added 18 points and six rebounds for Cleveland State. Up next Bowling Green plays Thursday against Niagara at home, and Cleveland State plays West Florida on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
